originality.rationale: The 2025 source establishes the three-member open-cycle equations and local symmetric fixed-point stability, but explicitly reports basin-dividing behavior as conjectural from numerics rather than proving the global raywise trichotomy or a positive-measure cone in which no biomass rescues extinction. The exact scalar forcing reduction, unique critical ray point, and composition-only no-rescue cone provide new implication strength. The 2012 Pavlovich–Bratus paper is a significant unresolved full-text comparison, explicitly retained as a historical originality risk; its accessible abstract/excerpts indicate parameter-dependent dynamics but not a mathematical theorem covering the quantified cone and threshold trichotomy.

value.rationale: The natural smallest n=3 cyclic open replicator used as the source population model has two interior equilibria but an unresolved global extinction/coexistence basin. A rigorous single critical mass on each positive-composition ray, including an infinite-mass obstruction on an explicit open set of strictly positive mixtures, establishes qualitative biomass-vs-diversity separation and a structural extinction geometry. These are motivated global ecological conclusions, not arbitrary small finite slices or a mere restatement of local stability.
